create_mesh: create a 3D mesh from an input image via POST /v1/meshes with prompt, format, and seed parameters
list_meshes: list all mesh generation jobs with optional pagination using after cursor and limit
retrieve_mesh: retrieve a specific mesh generation job by its mesh_id from the mesh store
delete_mesh: delete a mesh generation job by its mesh_id and return the deleted job status
download_mesh_content: download a generated mesh file (GLB or OBJ) by mesh_id from local storage
